commits.headline: feat(tools): tie report names to source names for ByteMatch's source view
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The NTSC-U report names functions by NTSC-U addresses and counts level
copies under their own names, while src/ defines each once under its PAL
or catalogue name, so ByteMatch could find almost none of NTSC-U's
functions in the repository. tools/gen_bytematch_names.py writes
include/bytematch_names.h from config/us/map.tsv, the level catalogues
and the front-end pairs: a #define from each report name src/ doesn't
define to the name it does, for the names the committed reports use.
Nothing…

commits.headline: docs(permuter): point to OpenRAC's shared permuter tool
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
OpenRAC's tools/permuter is this engine made game-agnostic. Its rac3/pal
and rac3/us profiles compile with check.py --keep-object and count a 0
only when check.py says MATCH. The note says how to run it; the tools
here are unchanged.
